{"reason": "Failure rows show two mislabeled-unknown patterns: forecast-bias=#t with bias 0.065–0.081 just under the 0.1 cutoff, and market-mismatch=#t rows with no EDI/lead-time signals, all truth=demand-forecast-error. I lower the bias threshold to 0.05 and widen that branch with market-signal-mismatch?, capturing these rows without touching the supplier-delay rule.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
